summary.en: At the bench near the stairs that lead to an abandoned temple, an old couple, named Hirunosuke Yanaka and Sayo Nezu, are talking about how each of them had a dream about the other one, when they see Kogoro and Conan looking for a notebook. The notebook has been kept by Nezu ever since she found it earlier this morning, and is then given back to Kogoro.

locations: Somewhere near the stairs at the abandoned temple
